stories.title: StudyOnTV — StudyOnTV (Tiledaoti TV) — open-source Android TV app where kids unlock screen time by answering questions. Runs fully on the T…
stories.author: chadyi
stories.snippet: StudyOnTV (Tiledaoti TV) — open-source Android TV app where kids unlock screen time by answering questions. Runs fully on the TV: no server, no account. Parents scan a QR code and manage questions from the LAN. Learn first. Watch later.
